avis.texte: I love Squishes, so naturally I got these patches. I purchased the bats ( Emily and Zumeriz ) and the cows ( Patty and Ronnie). They are really cute obviously, and stick very very well they can easily last a whole day if not two. I did deduct a star for the thickness though. They are less hydrocolic patch and more sticker. So they do form a barrier - but don't puff up and turn white except for the tiniest bit. It's not a lack of oil, but a lack of bandage if that makes sense. I only break out occasionally, so these are more of a collectors item that I get to wear sometime so the tradeoff is worth it to me. If you break out alot and want these to heal large or frequent acne spots I would get something else.
I like the strength this patch has in it. Adhered to the skin well. Stayed on for a full 24 hours without budging. Cleared up my blemish. Very happy with the results from my new purchase

Not only are they super cute but very effective. I have tried so many pimple patches and either they don't stick or they don't do anything to the pimple but these are wonderful and they work so well I'm thinking maybe some of the negative comments are because the pimples aren't open that they're applying them too can't place them on a closed zit and expected to do anything. They're usually has to be a whitehead for any pimple patch to work the best. Anyway, highly recommend.

I love squshmallows so I was very excited to get this. They stick great to your skin without irritation, but it didn't do much for my pimples. It would take about a week before I saw any results. I've used other patches and seen results in a couple days. Cute, but not for me.

They worked great. I have acne prone skin and tried them. I had a smell reaction because I placed one on what was probably a zit that was too developed and it became inflamed. otherwise, fantastic. I use them on small spots on my face and arms.

Kindly gifted by Tonymoly - this is the cutest collab! We love all the new pimple/blemish patch shapes and these are just the cutest for all ages tbh! These stick to the skin well even throughout the night.

avis.titre: The cutest most effective patches ever!!!
avis.texte: I've been using TONYMOLY skincare products for a while now, but this was my first time trying their blemish patches and I'm loving them! I was gifted by TONYMOLY to try their Emily Blemish Patches, and these have been so helpful. With the weather changing my skin is starting to breakout, so this was the perfect time for them Emily Blemish Patches. Firstly, how adorable are these patches!! They are so cute and I love how fun they are! I love that they have different sizes too. Including bigger patches is so helpful and useful and I appreciate that they created patches with different sizes for different zits/breakouts. These patches work so well and they do the job when it comes to getting rid of blemishes. I love using these overnight, and seeing my blemish fade or disappear in the morning. These are cute and effective and I can't recommend them more!!
I love squishmallows so I thought these would work on my acne prone skin. I tried to use one but when I went to take it off I was met with a sticky residue on my face and I saw no difference.

avis.titre: I loved this product, but I wish they weren't so BOLD at 37
avis.texte: These worked extremely well. They had niacinamide, which I badly needed at the time, and they were very effective against the breakout I was having. Plus, the larger patch where Patty & Ronnie are hugging was great for BIG zits and clusters. However, I knocked a point off for an inability to wear them outside, because my breakout was big, and I'm 37 years old. I can't.

This is about the only item in the entire squishmallows collection that I can comfortably say has thought put into it; it's refreshing to see a product designed to actually look like the charachters. TONYMOLY is notorious for their ultra-cute Character-shaped packaging, but nearly every Squishmallows collab item comes in a standard disposable squeeze tube/foil pack, or, more rarely, uses the standard packaging just in a slightly different color scheme. To say this collab has been a disappointment is an understatement. While it's nice to finally see a squishmallows item live up to expectations, it's a shame that the effort is wasted on a single-use disposable item. It would have been so much nicer if these came in a cute collector's container that squishmallow fans could keep once the patches themselves are all used up, but that would have required a component the brand was unwilling to put into this collection: effort.
I love squishmallows and I bought these. They work well but they almost melt off my face and leave a sticky residue when you take them off.
My daughter loves these things I'd never tried them before had a really big sit on my chin and it worked fairly well.

My daughter loves these things and I've never tried them had a bad sit on my chin and decided to give it a try to find out these things work rather well. And the fact that they're cute makes it not so inconvenient to have it on.

Not even joking... never have i been more obsessed with something.. first off, its so freakin cute but ut actually works! Like my pimples were conpletely flat the next day when i woke up. Its thinner than the hello kitty ones like SO MUCH better.
